Last updated: June 2025

What We Collect

When you make a booking or contact us, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and any preferences you share with us. We also collect standard analytics data when you visit this website.

How We Use It

We use your information to manage your reservation, communicate with you about your stay, and improve our service. We do not sell your data to third parties.

Cookies

This website uses cookies for analytics and to remember your preferences. You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at info@teatot.co.ke to make a request.

Contact

For any privacy-related questions, email us at info@teatot.co.ke.

Last updated: June 2025

Bookings

All bookings are subject to availability. A valid credit card is required to secure your reservation. Full payment is taken at check-in unless otherwise agreed at the time of booking.

Cancellation Policy

Cancellations made more than 48 hours before arrival are free of charge. Cancellations within 48 hours of arrival will be charged one night's room rate. No-shows will be charged the full booking amount.

Check-In & Check-Out

Check-in is from 2:00 PM. Check-out is by 12:00 noon. Late check-out is subject to availability and may incur an additional charge.

Liability

Tea Tot Hotels is not responsible for loss or damage to personal belongings. Guests are responsible for any damage caused to hotel property during their stay.

Contact

For any questions regarding these terms, contact us at info@teatot.co.ke.
